property_summary: Regardless of the input _l1FeeOverhead value, the reference always sets l1FeeOverhead to the supplied argument; the buggy version forces it to zero, so the invariant that l1FeeOverhead equals the provided parameter after the call holds for P but not for M when _l1FeeOverhead is non-zero.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to l1FeeOverhead with assignment of a constant zero
